method: actual production modules and vendored Three geometry; isolated DOM/compositor; no WebGL/art/performance claim

checks.name: protected timber projection and moving-door/interior/movement blocks unchanged
CPU sampler matches texel centres, flipY, bilinear interpolation and edges
fixed cover excludes cabin/porch, all four houses, six crate stacks and promenade
all six original curved palm collider projections are excluded, not just trunk centres
black tile roof uses three bounded draws, real courses/caps, not metallic sheets
roof geometry/material data are finite and seeded repeatable
actual generated wet pixels produce all requested impacts and matching GPU filters
all impact footprints remain wet/exposed, including dense circumference/drop-range probes
radii, ages, lives, cadence and spatial distribution are independently varied
read-only QA returns copies, no renderer/state mutation capability
deterministic rejection sampling honours optional exposure veto and never spawns on dry pixels
rings expand/fade and airborne motion rises then returns ballistically
actual storm pause/presentation freezes all effect clocks and buffers without consuming combat RNG
rain off stops emission/opacity and clocks; re-enable resumes without hidden births
impact frames only update uniforms, with a bounded three shared mesh batches
existing house geometry batching retains all tile instances, bounds and real hinged leaf

impacts.method: shared-wet-pixels / instanced rings, crowns and ballistic droplets
